lead.zh: 沿运行、监控、权限、故障与退役读十四个主题。先建立排查顺序，再用具体服务的配置与日志验证。
lead.en: Study fourteen topics covering runtime, monitoring, permissions, failure and retirement. Form an investigation order, then validate it against a service’s configuration and logs.

zh: 说出首字延迟和吞吐各自受什么影响，各给一个优化手段
给线上服务列出三件必须监控的事，并说明各自先查什么
供应商宣布模型退役时，能走一遍迁移评估的四个检查项
KV 缓存为什么会占满显存，何时需要分页或量化？
连续批处理提升吞吐，代价是什么？
速率限制与配额应该按什么维度设？
提示注入在运维日志里通常留下什么痕迹？
权限最小化在 AI 服务里具体落在哪三层？
服务中断时，先保什么、后保什么？
模型退役迁移，为什么先跑回滚再切换？
en: Say what drives time-to-first-token and throughput respectively, with one optimization for each
List three things a live service must monitor, and what to check first for each
When a vendor announces retirement, walk through the four migration-assessment checks
Why does the KV cache fill memory, and when do you need paging or quantisation?
Continuous batching raises throughput; what does it cost?
Which dimensions should rate limits and quotas use?
What traces does prompt injection usually leave in operational logs?
Where does least privilege land in an AI service?
During an outage, what do you protect first and what later?
Why rehearse rollback before switching during model retirement?

answers.zh: 首字延迟影响开始等待的时间，吞吐影响连续生成或并发能力。前者可先查输入处理与排队，后者可查批处理与硬件瓶颈；需用相同负载验证。
answers.en: Time to first token affects initial waiting; throughput affects generation/concurrency capacity. Investigate input processing and queues for the former, batching and hardware limits for the latter under equal load.

answers.zh: 先看任务完成率、延迟分布、错误、用量和权限异常。成本突增时对照请求数、输入长度、重试和工具调用记录，不立即归因于模型单价。
answers.en: Track completion, latency distribution, errors, usage and permission anomalies. For a cost spike, compare request count, input lengths, retries and tool calls before blaming the model rate.

answers.zh: 至少覆盖接口与流式、任务质量、工具与权限、成本与延迟，并核对数据条款和回滚。先在代表性请求上对比，达到预先约定的条件再切换。
answers.en: Cover interface/streaming, task quality, tools/permissions and cost/latency, plus data terms and rollback. Compare representative requests before switching against agreed criteria.

answers.zh: 每个并发请求都要为历史 token 保存键值向量，长度和并发上升时线性增长。并发高、上下文长或显存紧张时，分页、量化或缩短上下文才值得评估；先测命中率与延迟再选。
answers.en: Every concurrent request stores key/value vectors for prior tokens, growing linearly with length and concurrency. When concurrency, context or memory pressure is high, evaluate paging, quantisation or shorter context; measure hit rate and latency first.

answers.zh: 新请求会插进正在生成的批次，单请求的首字与完成延迟可能变长，调度和显存管理更复杂。吞吐提升不等于每个用户都更快，要同时看 P50/P99。
answers.en: New requests join an in-flight batch, so per-request time-to-first-token and completion can stretch, and scheduling plus memory management get harder. Higher throughput is not faster for every user; watch P50 and P99.

answers.zh: 至少按租户、密钥、请求数/分钟、token/分钟和并发数分开；再叠加工具调用与重试。只限请求数，长上下文请求仍可能拖垮成本与延迟。
answers.en: At least tenant, key, requests per minute, tokens per minute and concurrency; add tool calls and retries. Limiting request count alone still lets long-context calls wreck cost and latency.

answers.zh: 异常的工具名/参数、检索内容触发外部 URL、权限被拒后反复重试、同一会话突然改变任务。日志要能关联输入来源、工具调用与授权结果，否则只能看到失败。
answers.en: Unusual tool names or arguments, retrieved text triggering external URLs, repeated retries after permission denials, or a session abruptly changing task. Logs must link input source, tool calls and authorisation outcomes, or you only see failure.

answers.zh: 模型可见的工具清单、执行端的凭据与资源范围、数据层的行级/字段级访问。三层任一层放宽，模型提议就可能变成越权动作。
answers.en: The tool list visible to the model, credentials and resource scope at execution, and row/field access at the data layer. Loosen any layer and a model proposal can become an unauthorised action.

answers.zh: 先保鉴权、审计与可回滚的核心读写，再保非关键生成与实验流量；先切断有外部副作用的工具，再降级为只读或排队。顺序要事先写成 runbook，而不是临时决定。
answers.en: Protect authentication, audit and rollback-critical reads/writes first, then non-critical generation and experiments; cut tools with external side effects, then degrade to read-only or queueing. Write the order into a runbook in advance.

answers.zh: 新模型在接口、流式、工具调用和质量上都可能变；先证明能切回旧版本，再把流量按比例放大。没有回滚，一次切换失败就会变成全量事故。
answers.en: A new model can change interface, streaming, tool calls and quality; prove you can switch back before scaling traffic. Without rollback, one failed cutover becomes a full outage.

nextTask.zh: 从容量预算走到运行检查
nextTask.en: Move from a capacity budget to runtime checks
